title: Slovakian Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry recipe using Slovakian ingredients. This dish is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the stir fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and cook for another 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the cabbage and cook until it starts to wilt, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the creamy garlic sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the stir fry over nutty brown rice.
